description_en: Deletes a custom resolution policy of the current account by policy ID. A deleted policy cannot be recovered by using its original ID, and a new ID is generated when the policy is recreated. Disable the policy and verify the resolution results before deletion. After an address block policy is deleted, its scope is excluded from overlap checks with other policies. Actual resolution takes effect after configuration propagation. You can call SdnsListRuleCategories to verify the deletion
description_zh: 根据策略 Id 删除当前账号的自定义解析策略。删除后不能通过原 Id 恢复；重新创建会获得新的 Id。建议先停用并验证解析结果，再删除。删除地址段策略后，其范围不再参与其他策略的重叠检查；实际解析需等待配置传播。可通过 SdnsListRuleCategories 确认删除结果
name: SdnsDeleteRuleCategory

parameters.help_en: The policy ID of the current account. This parameter is required. You can obtain the ID from the Id field in the response of CreateSdnsRuleCategory or the list returned by SdnsListRuleCategories. Use a decimal string to prevent precision loss of large integers
parameters.help_zh: 当前账号的策略 Id，必须提供。可从 CreateSdnsRuleCategory 的 Id 或 SdnsListRuleCategories 的列表中获取；使用十进制字符串，避免大整数精度丢失
parameters.name: id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to troubleshoot API call issues. This is not the policy ID
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的标识，用于排查调用问题，不是策略 Id
